---
name: Corpus correction
about: Report an error in a corpus item
---

## Item ID

The ID of the item with the error (e.g., `OSHA_1910_1200_001`).

## Current text in corpus

The clause as it currently appears in the corpus.

## Correct text

How the text should read on eCFR today, or the reason the current text is wrong.

## eCFR fetch date

The date you verified this against eCFR (e.g., `2026-09-10`).

## eCFR link

The link to the relevant regulation on eCFR, if available.
